Hi Samira / Liam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Workload: ~1.2M messages/week, peak concurrency during EMEA business hours.
- Key concerns: data residency & audit logs, procurement timelines, and integration with your vendor intake process.

As discussed, it would help to capture a short stakeholder map so we can tailor the internal enablement materials and prioritize the right artifacts for procurement/security. Could you confirm the names/roles for:
1) Economic buyer (signs PO)
2) Security/contact for vendor intake (SOC2 / data handling)
3) Procurement lead (PO / SOW timelines)
4) Any exec sponsor / champion who will drive internal buy-in

Proposed next steps:
- Samira: share stakeholder names + any specific vendor intake checklist items (by end of week)
- I'll put together a short champion enablement pack (talk tracks, one-pager ROI, and a mutual action plan) and loop in our solutions lead.
- If useful, we can schedule a 30-minute enablement call for your champion + procurement/security the week of Aug 2.

Attached: mutual-action-plan-ATLAS.xlsx (simple timeline + milestones).

Thanks — looking forward to the stakeholder list.
